changed: numeric-magnitude regex features (bed/bath count, sqft, acreage, garage spaces, year built as NaN-capable floats) replacing exp-001's boolean-only flags
larger TF-IDF vocabulary (20k word + 20k char, up from 6k/6k)
log1p(listPrice) training target with expm1 back-transform, instead of raw-scale training
more model capacity: num_leaves=63, n_estimators=2500 fixed (up from num_leaves=31, n_estimators=300), no early-stopping holdout so 100% of fold data is used

rejected and documented (not adopted): sentence-embedding features (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and out-of-fold city gazetteer target-encoding, both tested on a holdout and found to not improve or slightly hurt score
